title: 7.9 More Feelings
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Say that it is a good or a bad day, that you are fine or great, and that someone is sick, angry or afraid.
grammar_function: It is a good/bad day.; How are you? I am fine/great; How is she/he? She/He is sick/angry/afraid.
prerequisite: 3.2-3.3 I am, she is, he is; 7.2 How are you? and How is she?; 2.11 It is a big house.; 4.x What day is it today?
speaking_outcome: Say It is a good day. and It is a bad day.; ask How are you? and answer I am fine.; say She is sick. and He is angry.
